title: Baby Doll Pacifier Recall by JA-RU
tell: Check for Model No. 1058 and the included pacifier on a string around the doll's neck.

product: Doll Craftin Curly-One Doll Cupie Dolls
title: Craft Dolls Recalled; Arms May Present Choking Hazard
tell: Check the model number and the "Doll Craftin" label on the cardboard header of the clear plastic packaging.

product: J.C. Penney food processor plastic bowl covers
title: Food Processor Bowl Covers Recalled by Moulinex
tell: Check the model number and date code stamped on the base of the appliance to see if it falls within the recalled dates and model numbers.

product: B and E Sales Company wooden puzzle train toys
title: Liquidating Corp. Issues Public Warning That "Wood Toy Puzzle Train" May Be Hazardous To Your Children
tell: All units are recalled. The set consists of one wooden engine car with a pull cord and two wooden boxcars with red wheels and geometric shapes.

title: Hardees Recalls Its Ghostblasters Toys
tell: All units are recalled. They are 3 inches by 1 1/4 inches by 1/2 inch in red, black, gray, or white with the Ghostbusters logo on one side and two black buttons.

product: Faulty Aquarium Light Cord Recalled By McCrory Stores
title: Faulty Aquarium Light Cord Recalled By McCrory Stores
tell: This applies only to aquariums purchased prior to March 1, 1989, identified by item number 951418 on the carton.

title: Whirlpool Will Retrofit Below-Counter Dishwashers
tell: Check the model number on a plate on the right front edge of the tub after the door is opened.

product: Seamore the Action Seahorsell Tub and Pool Toys
title: Seamore The Action Seahorse Bath Rings Retrofit by Century
tell: Date codes over 8812 have improved assemblies and are not affected; check the date code on the packing carton or the underside of the seat visible through three holes on the bottom.

product: Kawasaki Big Wheel battery-operated ride-on toys
title: Replacement Of "On" Switch Offered For Big Wheel Battery-Operated Riding Toy
tell: All units of the Kawasaki KLT 250 Prairie Big Wheel (item numbers 1215, 1220, 1223) and Sweet-Tee-Nuff Big Wheel (item number 1221) with Kawasaki or Sweet-Tee-Nuff decals are recalled.

product: Playskool Color In Contrast Busy Boxes toys
title: Color In Contrast Busy Box Recalled by Playskool
tell: Check the item number 5388 to identify the recalled Color In Contrast Busy Box.

product: K Mart Baby Mirror Rattles man with a hat rattles
title: K-Mart Recalling Two Rattles
tell: This recall includes only the man with a hat style of the Baby Mirror Rattle and the snail style of the Baby Wheel Rattle.

product: L'il Tots Baby's First Gift Sets Hanging Melody Bells
title: L'il Tots Crib Toy Recalled
tell: All units of the Hanging Melody Bells included in the Baby's First Gift Sets are recalled.

product: Para Mi Bebe Baby Bath soap for infants bottle cap rattles
title: Rattle Caps For Baby Soap & Cologne Recalled by Orion
tell: All units are not recalled; only ball-shaped blue and pink rattle caps with a gold band from Baby Cologne #30618, Baby Bath #30619, and Baby Set #30633 are included.

product: Creative Years Magnetic Building Block toys
title: Creative Years Blocks Toy Train Are Recalled
tell: You can identify the recalled toys by model numbers 9516 and 9521 for the blocks, and style 505 for the train, found on the cardboard packaging.

title: American International Recalling Doll Because Of Potential Choking Hazard
tell: All units are not recalled; the recall involves item number 2065PVC packaged in a clear carrying case with a smaller doll and a bottle.

product: Toys "R" Us, Inc. Recalls Toot Toot Tug Boat Because Of Potential Choking Hazards
title: Toys "R" Us, Inc. Recalls Toot Toot Tug Boat Because Of Potential Choking Hazards
tell: All units are recalled. The product is identified as Primex/Shyf #4768 Toot Toot Tug.

product: Three Baby Strollers Recalled By Mccrory
title: Three Baby Strollers Recalled By Mccrory
tell: Check the model, item number, and the manufacturing date on the caution label sewn on the seat back; units manufactured on May 1, 1987, or later are not recalled.

title: Coca-Cola Foods Recalls Its "Cool Cuffs"
tell: All units of the Hi-C Cool Cuff promotional wristbands are recalled.

title: Spinning Bee Toy Recalled by Artsana Of America (Chicco)
tell: You can identify the recalled toy by model 64063, 'Chicco' embossed on the yellow collar, and 'Made in the USA' on the bottom; those imported from Italy are not recalled.

product: Sears Craftsman gasoline powered string trimmers
title: Firm To Provide Guard For String Trimmer
tell: Check the model number found on the side of the trimmer or on the decal describing how to start the trimmer to see if it matches the recalled model numbers.

title: Ceiling Fans Recalled by Sears
tell: All units of the Smurf and Snoopy 48-inch white ceiling fans are recalled.

title: Lionel Leisure, Inc. Recalling Snoopy Wind-Up Train Because Of Small Parts
tell: All units of the Snoopy Wind-Up Train toy are recalled; it is a 12-inch-long red and white plastic train with decorative Snoopy figures and model number 711.

product: Jerry Elsner Company Christmas stockings with teddy bear decorations
title: Christmas Stocking Decorative Bear Recalled As Choking Hazard
tell: All units are recalled. The 12-inch red and white furry stocking features a brown stuffed teddy bear head wearing a Santa hat and two small bells on a green bow ribbon.

product: Steven Barrie Mother's Helper Hot Stuff pacifier holders
title: Choking Hazard Prompts Pacifier Holder Recall
tell: All units are recalled if they feature raised, multi-colored designs and letters reading I'm a 10, I'M A BOY, or Hot Stuff on the front, with specific text embossed on the back.

product: Retrofit Program for Speed Queen Contempo Mate Washer/Dryer
title: Retrofit Program for Speed Queen Contempo Mate Washer/Dryer
tell: All units equipped with caster-rollers are included in this retrofit program.

title: Baby Bibs, Pants & Panties Recalled by Mullins Square
tell: Recalled items have decorative plastic eyes; items with decorative fabric eyes are not recalled. The pants and panties have a label reading Mullins Square Austin Texas.

title: Franklin Sports Industries, Inc, Recalls All Of Its Lawn Darts
tell: All units are recalled. Check for the permanently embossed FRANKLIN logo and the warning on two of the wings.

product: Rowenta Coffee Maker and Water Boiler
title: Fire Hazard: Hot Water, Coffee Makers Are Recalled By Rowenta
tell: Check the model number FK-91 or FK-95 imprinted on the back of the white plastic units along with Rowenta Made in W. Germany on the front and back.

title: Soft Drink Vending Machines To Be Retrofitted By Vendo
tell: All units with widths in excess of 38.5 inches manufactured between 1982 and 1985 without anti-theft devices are recalled.

product: Temporary Power Tap three-wire extension power strips
title: Shock Hazard Prompts Recall Of Extension Power Strip
tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the metal base for the label reading Temporary Power Tap and Model No. WP-002B.

product: Four Charmglow Bug Killers Recalled For Fire Hazard
title: Four Charmglow Bug Killers Recalled For Fire Hazard
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model numbers 071512, 073425, 074001, and 078012 printed on the label affixed to the top of the unit.

title: Pelonis Portable Electrtc Heater Recalled
tell: Check the model number and serial number ranging from 10,001US through 119,000US to identify affected units.

product: Crib Pals Tiny Tinkers Rattle Copter helicopter baby rattles
title: Toys R Us Recalling 12,000 Baby Rattles
tell: You can identify the recalled rattle copter by checking the bottom for the imprint Royal Co. Ltd. Japan 198711; only the helicopter rattle from the single or set is recalled.

title: Potential Strangulation Risk Prompts Baby Mirror Recall
tell: All units are recalled. The flexible plastic edging may be blue or red, and a decal with a yellow bear and Bright Reflections is included.

title: Cutie Pie Dolls Recalled For Potential Choking Hazards
tell: All units are recalled. Look for the label Largo Toys, New York 20222 imprinted on the back of the head.

product: Blue Box Crib Activity Play Doggie crib toys
title: Choking Hazard Prompts Recall Of Crib Toys, Dolls
tell: All units of these Blue Box crib toys and dolls are recalled. Check the back of the Crib Activity Play Doggie for BLUE BOX MADE IN SINGAPORE, the Play Mirror for BLUE BOX, and the doll's back for CHINA.

product: T-Fal Safety Super Fryer deep fat fryers
title: Wiring Problem Prompts Deep Fat Fryer Inspection
tell: You can tell a recalled unit by checking the bottom of the fryer for type 8215 and a three or four digit manufacturing code ending in 6, 7, or 8.

title: Choking Hazard Leads To Recall Of 2 Dolls
tell: Consumers can identify the recalled dolls by checking model numbers 41215, 09-41215, or 35350 on the packaging, as the Lovee label only appears on the package and not on the dolls themselves.

title: Eyes And Nose Are Choking-Hazards On Koala Bear Fur Banks
tell: All units are recalled. They are six inch tall koala bear fur banks with a paper label on the chest reading I AM A BANK.

title: Blue Box Crib Toy Recalled
tell: All units are recalled. The words Blue-Box and Made in Singapore are molded on the blue plastic bar.

product: Potential Strangulation Risk Prompts Toys R Us To Recall Crib Toy
title: Potential Strangulation Risk Prompts Toys R Us To Recall Crib Toy
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the toy by the label attached reading Softee Learners and Made in China, with care instructions on the reverse side.

product: Franklin Mike Schmidt Batting Tee with Return Ball Trainer
title: Franklin Sports Recalls Baseball, Soccer Training Sets
tell: You can identify the recalled units by checking the model numbers 1595, 1597, 1598, and 1758, which include a metal ground stake or spike.

title: Toy Kitchen Is Recalled; Parts May Cause Choking
tell: All units of the Cook N Clean Kitchen toy are recalled.

title: Toy Fire Boat Recalled By Target Stores
tell: All units are recalled. It is a white, red and blue plastic fire boat with a fireman pilot and model number 2311.

title: Toro Recalls Rear Engine Riding Mowers
tell: You can identify the recalled mowers by the model numbers and serial ranges listed on the engine base plate located to the left of the engine.

product: Choking Hazard Prompts Rite-Aide Doll Recall
title: Choking Hazard Prompts Rite-Aide Doll Recall
tell: All units of this doll are recalled.

product: M. Adler's Son Flower Rattle plastic flower-shaped baby rattles
title: Choking Hazard Prompts Recall Of Flower Rattle
tell: All units of the Flower Rattle model No. M6588 are recalled.

product: Holiday Brass Candle Lamp Recalled By Bradlees
title: Holiday Brass Candle Lamp Recalled By Bradlees
tell: You can identify the recalled lamp by style number 95062.

product: Stahlwood Youngtimes Klick-Klack Rattle baby rattles
title: Customs' Seizure Leads To Recall Of Toy Rattles
tell: All units of this product are recalled; it is a 6 1/2-inch long plastic barbell-shaped rattle bearing the imprint of Stahlwood Toy N.Y.

title: Craft Dolls And Rattles Recalled For Possible Choking Hazards
tell: All units of the listed model numbers are recalled; check the model number on the item.

title: Coleman Offers Repair Kit For Powermate Generator
tell: Recalled units are Model PM 3000 generators with serial numbers below 193180, manufactured between December 1983 and September 1988.

title: CPSC Wants "Monster" Ride Inspected For Defects
tell: All units of the Monster amusement ride are covered by this inspection notice.

title: Cool Flute and Binoculars Recalled by Kellogg
tell: All Cool Flute toys from Corn Pops cereal and all Binoculars distributed in Fruity Marshmallow Krispies, Cocoa Krispies, Rice Krispies, and Pop Tarts are recalled.

product: Creative Playthings expandable wooden enclosures for infants and toddlers
title: Child Enclosures Recalled by Several Companies
tell: All units of these old accordion style expandable wooden enclosures are recalled.

title: Safety Pin Rattle Recalled by Fiber-Craft Materials Corp.
tell: All units are recalled. They are blue, pink, or yellow plastic, shaped like a safety pin, and approximately four inches long with model number 4642.

product: Acme Plastic Racing Car carnival prize toys
title: Race Cars, Jetplanes & Speedcycles Recalled by Acme Premium Supply
tell: All units of items C805, C822, and C900 are recalled.

title: Imported Toys Recalled by Lil' Mort Sales
tell: All units of these imported toys sold by Lil' Mort Sales are recalled.

product: Franklin Yard Dart Sets, Three, Five Game Combination Sets
title: Lawn Darts Recalled By Franklin Sports Industries
tell: All units are recalled. Consumers should check for the permanently embossed FRANKLIN logo and warning on two of the wings.

product: E-Z Go Strollers Recalled By Century
title: E-Z Go Strollers Recalled By Century
tell: Check the model number, which is found on the instruction sheet and on the stroller's legs.

title: Consumers Were Urged To Replace Horn On Century Roadster Walker
tell: Check the date of manufacture on the carton and on a sticker located underneath the fender; walkers manufactured after January 1, 1989 do not need to be replaced.
